method: Retained native paths with outer/top/right clips expanded, all transforms and header-bottom/left limits preserved. Poppler600dpi honours source ICCs into explicit sRGB, followed by original FOGRA39 relative1/noBPC. Only narrow opaque CMYK top/right raster strips are supplied, strictly clipped outside TrimBox. Original production page content and artwork remain unmodified.
reconstructibleInputs: Full600dpi RGB rasters and expanded native derivation pages removed after strip extraction for overlay-only runs; hashes retained. Two selected samples remain separately.
